appBundle.description: iOS bundle id or Android applicationId. The server sends APNs to this topic.

capabilities.description:
What the app can do with a push: dataMessages (Android FCM data messages) and
serviceExtension (iOS notification service extension). Unknown values are rejected.

environment.description: APNs only: sandbox or production, the APNs host the token belongs to.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag the server renders notification text in, e.g. zh-CN.

platform.description: Native platform: android, ios or harmony.

provider.description: OS delivery provider: fcm, apns or getui.

token.description: OS-issued token. Never log or persist outside protected native storage.
